description: Model Council gateway routing cases. Expected capabilities are intentionally broader than one exact model trio.

cases.prompt: Design a production rate-limiting architecture for a multi-tenant API and compare its scaling and failure tradeoffs.
Debug a TypeScript function that intermittently returns stale cached data and propose a focused fix.
Briefly write a SQL query that returns each customer's latest completed order.
Diagnose a production Kubernetes service whose latency spikes during rolling deployments and give a safe mitigation plan.
Design cursor pagination for an API that serves a frequently changing event stream.
Review the security risks of accepting customer-supplied webhook URLs in production and recommend controls.
Compare breadth-first and bidirectional search algorithms for a large social graph and recommend when to use each.
Propose a database schema for reusable prompt templates with version history and tags.
Write an executive email announcing a two-week project delay while maintaining confidence and accountability.
Rewrite this briefly and in plain English: We are operationalizing a cross-functional optimization initiative.
Write five landing-page headlines for a tool that helps teams compare AI models.
Briefly summarize a quarterly report for a company-wide update while preserving the main risks.
Draft a sincere customer apology for a service interruption without making promises the company cannot keep.
Compare build-versus-buy options for an internal analytics platform and recommend a decision framework.
Analyze the financial risks of moving from annual contracts to usage-based pricing.
Create a strategy for evaluating whether a developer product should expand into a new market.
Research is unavailable; explain how you would compare three uncertain options without inventing evidence.
Forecast the operational risks of doubling customer traffic and clearly state uncertainty.
Explain photosynthesis simply to a ten-year-old.
Explain opportunity cost in plain English with one everyday example.
In one sentence, explain why the sky appears blue.
Concisely explain the difference between correlation and causation.
Explain how ocean tides work in plain English.
Suggest ten memorable names for a weekly product discussion.
Create a practical packing checklist for a three-day rainy-weather trip.
Give me five vegetarian dinner ideas using common pantry ingredients.
